title: Great idea... but,....
text: Great idea... but,..... Is a great idea and with a little tweaking, it still can be.  The magnets on the canisters are worthless.  They can't even hold themselves up when empty.  I just ordered some magnets that I'm going to glue on so that I can use them.  Would have been nice if they would have gone that extra bit and used workable magnets, instead of wasting money and time assembling something that won't work.  Then wasting my money and time having to do more for this product.  I'm excited though for when I can actually put them up... they better work.
